title: Fancy Zones not working on startup

judgment.rationale: The on/off recovery and boot trigger are concrete, but they do not prove why the initial module startup fails.
evidence: On Store 0.99.1 FancyZones shows enabled after boot but becomes active only after an off/on toggle.
The reporter provided a PowerToys report ZIP; the report does not identify a confirmed shared cause with the backup-restore issue.
FancyZones module enable/disable logic is in https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp.

fix_assessment.rationale: The on/off recovery and boot trigger are concrete, but they do not prove why the initial module startup fails.

proposed_fixes.title: Start enabled FancyZones reliably at sign-in
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The startup module launch or its initialization may fail before the manual restart, but the attachment has not been analyzed for a specific failure.
plan: Reproduce Windows sign-in with FancyZones already enabled and PowerToys configured to start automatically.
Compare FancyZones process and startup initialization before and after toggling, using the supplied report as supporting evidence.
Correct the confirmed startup lifecycle failure and add a regression for startup when the persisted enabled setting is true.
verification: FancyZones activates on sign-in without a manual toggle, while disabling it still stops it.

confidence.rationale: The on/off recovery and boot trigger are concrete, but they do not prove why the initial module startup fails.

prerequisites: PowerToys configured to start at Windows sign-in
setup: Enable FancyZones and configure a recognizable layout.
steps: Before opening the editor, try zoning a window.
Toggle FancyZones off and on and repeat.
